module: Rally snaproad: a "magnetic road" built on the points of a driveline (PointList). It lets you project a position onto the road (closestSnapResult, with cumulative distance along the road), move forward or backward by a given distance, compute normals, partition the road around the pacenotes (partition, partition_all, filter) and reproject the pacenote waypoints when the road changes. It also contains the debugDrawer drawing functions used by the rally editor and the recce app. The module returns a constructor: Snaproad(driveline).
usage:
local Snaproad = require('/lua/ge/extensions/gameplay/rally/snaproad')
local sr = Snaproad(pointList)
local loc = sr:closestSnapResult(veh:getPosition())
print(loc.distanceAlongRoute, sr:totalRouteLength())
notes: A "snap result" (route location) is a table {pos, point, nearestPoint, fromPoint, toPoint, segmentIndex, xnorm, distanceAlongRoute (m), distSq (m²)}.
The points are tables with pos (vec3), id (sequential index) and prev / next links; the spatial index is a kd-tree rebuilt if the points table changes.
The useAllPoints argument ignores the active filter (filter) and works on all the driveline's points; otherwise, if a filter is active, only its bounds are used to bound the result.
minAdjacentWaypointDistance is 2.0 m: the start and end waypoints of a pacenote are pushed apart to respect this gap (_repairPacenoteProjectionEntries).

Possible inconsistency: rallyManager passes a PointList to the constructor, whereas recce:createPacenotesData calls Snaproad(self) with the Recce object; Snaproad reads driveline().points, so with a Recce the points field does not exist (the driveline is in recce.driveline there).
groupPointsByCornerCall depends on self.styleData, which is never defined in this file: the function returns an empty table unless external code assigns styleData.
Several functions set point.partition on the points: this state is stored directly in the driveline's points.

C.desc: Snaproad object returned by the constructor.

init.desc: Stores the driveline, creates the camera path reader, initializes filter, partition, partition_all, global opacity and the points index.

setGlobalOpacity.desc: Sets the global opacity of the debug drawings.

driveline.desc: Returns the driveline passed to the constructor.

_allPoints.desc: All the driveline's points (empty table if there is no driveline).

_operativePoints.desc: The filter's points if active, otherwise all points.

_rebuildAllPointIndex.desc: Rebuilds the index (kd-tree, cumulative distances) of all points.

_indexForPoints.desc: Returns the points index (all or filtered), rebuilt if the points table changed.

minAdjacentWaypointDistance.desc: Minimum gap between adjacent waypoints: 2.0 m.

totalRouteLength.desc: Total length of the road (all points).

routeLocationForPoint.desc: Builds the snap result corresponding exactly to a driveline point.

returns.desc: Snap result; nil if the point is unknown

compareRouteLocations.desc: Compares two positions on the road according to their distanceAlongRoute.

returns.desc: -1 if a is before b, 0 if equal (gap < 0.0001 m), 1 if a is after b; nil if data is missing

distanceBetweenRouteLocations.desc: Absolute distance between two snap results, along the road.

normalForSnapResult.desc: Forward normal of a snap result (computed on the fromPoint/toPoint segment, or via the closest point if the segment is degenerate).

positionAtDistanceAlongRoute.desc: Position on the road at a given cumulative distance (clamped between 0 and the total length), interpolated on the relevant segment.

distanceAlongRoute.desc: Distance from the start of the road, in meters

returns.desc: Snap result; nil if there are no points

advanceAlongRoute.desc: Projects pos onto the road then moves forward (fwd = true) or backward by meters along the road, without exceeding the limit points.

limitPoints.desc: Points the result must not exceed

distanceBetweenPositions.desc: Distance along the road between the projections of two positions.

_snapshotWaypoint.desc: Reads from a snapshot the position, normal and location of a waypoint (cs or ce), falling back to the current waypoint.

_applySnapLocationToWaypoint.desc: Applies the position and normal of a snap result to a waypoint.

_repairPacenoteProjectionEntries.desc: Fixes the ordered list of pacenote projections so that each end is at least 2 m after its start and the pacenotes do not overlap, by shifting the distances and staying within the road length.

reprojectPacenoteWaypointsFromSnapshot.desc: Reprojects onto the current road the cs/ce waypoints of all non-missing pacenotes, from a snapshot, repairs overlaps, updates the halfpoints and recomputes the distance calls (autofillDistanceCalls).

reprojectPacenoteWaypoints.desc: Reprojects the pacenote waypoints. Without a snapshot, builds one from the current positions (and from the old snaproad if provided).

closestSnapResult.desc: Projects a position onto the road: finds the closest point (kd-tree) then the best segment in a window of 6 segments around it. If a filter with bounds is active, clamps the result between those bounds.

returns.desc: Snap result; nil if no points

closestSnapPoint.desc: Road point closest to a position.

closestSnapPos.desc: Position projected onto the road; returns source_pos as is if the projection fails.

normalAlignPoints.desc: Returns (previous, current, next) of a point (delegated to snaproad/normals).

forwardNormalVec.desc: Forward normal of a point (delegated to snaproad/normals).

pointsBackwards.desc: Moves back a given number of points, stopping before a limit point.

pointsForwards.desc: Moves forward a given number of points, stopping before a limit point.

distanceBackwards.desc: Moves back point by point until a distance in meters is exceeded, or before a limit point.

distanceBackwardsResult.desc: Like advanceAlongRoute backward, from a position.

distanceForwards.desc: Moves forward point by point until a distance in meters is exceeded, or before a limit point.

distanceForwardsResult.desc: Like advanceAlongRoute forward, from a position.

prevSnapPoint.desc: Point preceding the point closest to srcPos (the point itself at the start).

prevSnapPos.desc: Position of the point returned by prevSnapPoint (error if nil).

nextSnapPoint.desc: Point following the point closest to srcPos (the point itself at the end).

nextSnapPos.desc: Position of the point returned by nextSnapPoint (error if nil).

updateHalfpoint.desc: Computes the midpoint (in distance along the road) between the start and the end of the pacenote and stores it in pn.halfpoint, halfpointLocation, halfpointPos.

setPartitionToPacenote.desc: Sets the "focus" partition on the portion of road going from the start to the end of the pacenote.

clearPartition.desc: Disables and empties the current partition.

_partitionPoints.desc: Splits the road into before points, focus points (from fromPoint to toPoint) and after points, and marks the focus points with partition.

clearAll.desc: Disables the partition of all pacenotes, clears the filter and the partitions cached on the points.

_clearPointCachedPartitions.desc: Sets point.partition to nil on all points.

partitionAllPacenotes.desc: Splits the whole road between the pacenotes: one partition per interval before each pacenote and one per pacenote. Also fills in _driveline_location and _driveline_point on the waypoints.

setFilterToAllPartitions.desc: Enables a filter containing all the points of the partitions (requires partitionAllPacenotes first).

setFilterPartitionPoint.desc: Enables a filter limited to the partition containing the given point.

setFilter.desc: Enables a filter that limits the movable points of a pacenote waypoint between the neighboring pacenotes (with a 2 m margin).

setPartitionToFilter.desc: Sets the "focus" partition on the portion of road covered by the active filter.

measurePartition.desc: Measures the geometry of the current partition's corner (geoPacenotes.measurePartition) on its focus points.

pointsForCameraPath.desc: List of road points around the current partition for a camera path (40 m before and 20 m after by default).

returns.desc: Points; nil without an active partition

partitionAllEnabled.desc: Indicates whether the partition of all pacenotes is active.

toggleCornerCalls.desc: Toggles the display of corner calls and recomputes the current pacenote's partition.

groupPointsByCornerCall.desc: Groups points by corner call according to styleData (see notes: returns {} if styleData is not defined).

_drawDebugPointPrisms.desc: Draws prisms (debugDrawer:drawSquarePrism) between consecutive points, with color, height and opacity.

fromLocation.desc: Start limited by a snap result

toLocation.desc: End limited by a snap result

drawOnTop.desc: Draw on top of the scene

_drawDebugPartitionAllPrisms.desc: Draws the prisms of a partition.

_drawDebugPoints.desc: Draws spheres at the given points.

_drawDebugPointsCyl.desc: Draws cylinders at the given points.

_drawDebugPartitionsAll.desc: Draws all the partitions (used for Ctrl+click to create a new pacenote, according to the code comment).

drawDebugPartitionsAllWindow.desc: Draws only the partitions that overlap a distance window.

_drawDebugPartition.desc: Draws the current partition: before, focus, after.

drawDebugSnaproad.desc: Main drawing: the partition if active, otherwise the partition of all pacenotes, otherwise all points.

drawDebugRecceApp.desc: Drawing for the recce app: the partition if active, otherwise all points (with height adjustment).

drawDebugCameraPlaying.desc: Drawing during camera path playback (pacenote of the current partition).
